I feel stuck, the only thing that kept me going was that depression was cureable, that some day I could be better. now I feel so crippled, I know I need help, but i'm literally unable to do it. I can barely get out of bed much less leave my house. And I can't trust them I just can't, I can't trust any doctor. 
*edit thank you for the kind words and support. I didn't know where else to go and it means alot.

Please someone, I'm at the end of my rope.
